bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: Local browser cache index for this profile is out of sync with secure storage (ERR_CACHE_INDEX_MISMATCH, 0xCCH0). You may experience slow loads, missing assets, or repeated sign-in prompts. Recommended: rebuild the cache index and rescan service worker data. This will not affect bookmarks or history.
